capabilities: Plan and log timed activities in daily notes via quick entry
Split activity minutes across projects and keep automatic totals
Generate period summaries with day markers and streaks
Review totals, shares and days needing attention
Undo, redo and recover interrupted note edits
disambiguation: Not a general task manager; it plans and logs timed activities only in YYYY-MM-DD.md daily notes with a specific row syntax.
extras: Desktop only; Windows is the tested release platform and mobile is not advertised as supported. The plugin ID changed from plain-planner to thejaz-planner at 0.2.85 and ships a migration script; README includes detailed privacy and recovery-data notes.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes have no structured way to plan, log and total timed activities or split credit across projects while keeping notes fully readable Markdown.
summary: Day planner that plans and logs timed activities in plain Markdown daily notes, computes project credit totals, and shows period reviews.
